connector.name: muro - Live Chat & AI Support Inbox
connector.registryDescription: Live chat + AI support inbox: list, triage, and reply to customer conversations; configure widgets.
connector.summary: Hosted at muro.chat over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace chat.muro, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: muro API key sent as a Bearer token. Create it in the muro dashboard: Settings > API keys.
